verdict.rationale: ZCode clearly ships a desktop app on macOS, Windows and Linux beta (Electron, GUI-first), and it claims multi-agent collaboration, which loosely suggests parallel work. No evidence explicitly describes a visual diff viewer or running multiple sessions side by side; a community comparison to Codex's UI and praise for its HCI only imply such a workbench. Missing for 10: documented visual diff review, documented side-by-side multi-session support, and hands-on corroboration of either.
